In July, specifically on the 12th of the month, Hailey seeks feedback from LiHua regarding the artisanal donuts that Hailey has been developing. After LiHua tries and enjoys the donuts, expressing particular appreciation for the chocolate hazelnut flavor, Hailey inquires about LiHua's favorite flavor among the donuts to gain insights for further improvements. This exchange showcases Hailey's desire to refine their product offerings based on direct customer input. LiHua suggests adding seasonal fruit flavors, such as raspberry or lemon, as potential refreshing additions to the variety. Hailey takes this suggestion into consideration, appreciating LiHua's contribution and openness to new ideas, and assures her that she will explore these fruit flavor options for the bakery.
